items.title: Ossi Runne
items.summary: Yrjö Osvald "Ossi" Rundberg was a Finnish trumpeter, orchestra leader, composer, and record producer. He was born in Viipuri, Finland. He conducted Finland's entries at the Eurovision Song Contest. He first conducted the entry "Playboy" at Luxembourg in 1966.
